info.name: 1Factory Part Master API
info.description:
This API allows you to create and query a number of objects in your 1Factory account.

Contact Support:
 Name: API Support
 Email: support@1factory.com

item.name: 1Factory Defines Assembly Relationships Between Part Masters

request.description: Defines (or replaces) the list of parts that make up an assembly part. All referenced part numbers & revisions must already exist as Part Master entries.

response.name: OK. Set assembly on Part Master entry. Part Master entry for which the assembly was created is returned.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

response.name: Invalid request. A problem with the request prevented it from being processed.

response.name: Unauthorized. Missing or invalid API key.

item.name: 1Factory Creates a New (or Updates Existing) Part Master Entry for Your…

request.description:
Create a new part master entry that can be used when referring to parts when creating Plans, Inspections, FAIs etc.

The part number and rev must be unique - if a part master with the same part number and revision already exists, the existing Part Master entry will be overwritten.

response.name: OK. Successfully updated part master entry is returned.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

response.name: Created. Successfully created part master entry is returned.

item.name: 1Factory Gets a List of Part Masters for Your Organization

query.description: Starting page for queried rows - defaults to 0 (the start of the list). Returned rows will start at index (page * page_size).
The maximum number of records to return from the query. Defaults to 100, maximum value 500.
Part name / number to filter on.
Part rev to filter on. Typically used in conjunction with the part_number query parameter.
Parent Part number to filter on for Table of Size entries.
Parent Part rev to filter on for Table of Size entries.
If the part is a configured as a library.
If the part is a configured as an assembly.
If the part is a configured as an ITAR part.
If the part has any PPAP documents.
If the part has any PPAP documents.

Name of project_identifier to filter on. Must come from your organization's Part Master Project Identifier LOV. 

(The name used in the UI for this LOV is configured in your organization's Part Master settings and might not be 'Project Identifier').
Status to filter on.
Return objects created after the specified date-time
Return objects created before the specified date-time
Return objects updated after the specified date-time
Return objects updated before the specified date-time

request.description:
The list of part master entries that can be filtered by specifying query parameters.
Paging parameters control the number of rows of part master objects returned. By default, the first 100 part masters are returned.

response.name: Returns a list of part masters, most recently updated first. Utilize paging query parameters to query older part masters. By default the 100 most recent are returned.

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey
